request.subject: Request for distribution statements
request.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

As a member of your society, I would like to obtain my detailed distribution statements — per work, per period and per source of exploitation — for the last four quarters, together with the detail of the amounts currently being processed.

You can send them to me as PDF or CSV, in reply to this message.

Thank you in advance.

Kind regards,
{signer}
